requirements.quote: and shall meet EMC Class A to CISPR 32 and 35
requirements.text: Equipment must comply with EMC Class A to CISPR 32 and 35.

requirements.quote: Rack power equipment shall report telemetry over Redfish, PMBus, Modbus or CANbus
requirements.text: Rack power equipment must support telemetry reporting via specified protocols.

requirements.quote: Heat rejection shall use closed-circuit dry coolers, with no cooling-tower blowdown in the base design. Bidders proposing adiabatic assist for peak ambient shall state annual water use
requirements.text: Heat rejection must use closed-circuit dry coolers, and adiabatic assist proposals must include annual water use.

requirements.quote: Central utility buildings shall house chillers, pumps and facility water distribution serving the CDUs and room air handlers. Chillers may run on a decoupled 4.16 kV bus, with pumps, coolers and controls on 480 V
requirements.text: Central utility buildings must house chillers, pumps, and water distribution, with specified electrical configurations.

requirements.quote: The liquid cooling design point shall be facility water up to 45 °C, and bidders shall state maximum water inlet and expected outlet temperatures
requirements.text: Liquid cooling must handle facility water up to 45 °C, with stated inlet and outlet temperatures.

requirements.quote: CDUs shall be liquid-to-liquid, modular and placed in mechanical galleries with N+1 group redundancy. They take facility water on the primary side and cool a separate technical-grade secondary loop that serves GPU cold plates at a design flow of at least 1.5 LPM per kW
requirements.text: CDUs must be modular, redundant, and meet specified cooling flow requirements.

requirements.quote: CDU data shall state rated kW, pump type and count, primary and secondary supply and return temperatures, secondary flow in L/min, available lift in kPa, filter mesh, pipe routing and power supply
requirements.text: CDU data must include detailed specifications and parameters.

requirements.quote: The heat-rejection and water loops shall be concurrently maintainable in a ring with N+1 redundancy
requirements.text: Heat-rejection and water loops must be maintainable with N+1 redundancy.

requirements.quote: Room air handlers on medium-temperature facility water shall cool air-cooled equipment and occupied spaces. Air-side capacity shall be at least 15% of room load, and bidders shall state the liquid-captured fraction, with 90% as the target
requirements.text: Room air handlers must meet cooling and capacity requirements, with specified liquid-captured fraction.

requirements.quote: The plant shall reject the full heat load at 35 °C ambient for extended periods and at 40 °C on peak days, and bidders shall show approach temperatures for both cases
requirements.text: The plant must handle specified heat loads at given ambient temperatures, with approach temperatures stated.

requirements.quote: Air-cooled equipment shall operate with ASHRAE A2 supply air, and operation at A3 is preferred. Auxiliary racks above 20 kW sustained may need additional liquid cooling
requirements.text: Air-cooled equipment must meet ASHRAE A2 standards, with A3 preferred, and auxiliary racks may need extra cooling.

requirements.quote: The GPU-side cooling plant is not UPS-backed in the reference design and relies on loop thermal mass until backup generation restarts it. Bidders shall state the thermal ride-through time at full load and the automatic restart sequence
requirements.text: GPU-side cooling plant must have specified thermal ride-through and restart sequence details.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall deliver a chemical management plan covering additives and cooling-water properties, including transport, storage, filling, draining and disposal, nine months before delivery
requirements.text: A chemical management plan must be delivered nine months before delivery.

requirements.quote: Cooling shall be measured per node and per loop, with sampling frequency, accuracy and timestamps stated
requirements.text: Cooling measurements must include per-node and per-loop data with specified details.

requirements.quote: Piping routes, floor loading and weight per rack in t/m² shall be stated for each hall
requirements.text: Piping routes, floor loading, and rack weight must be specified for each hall.

requirements.quote: Prefabricated cooling equipment shall suit outdoor use at ·20 to +45 °C, or the local 20-year extreme if more stringent, with corrosion protection tested to ISO 12944-6 or equivalent
requirements.text: Prefabricated cooling equipment must meet outdoor use and corrosion protection standards.

requirements.quote: The compute system shall comprise a control plane of at least five servers, a GPU accelerator partition in direct-liquid-cooled cabinets, a CPU data-preparation partition, a high-speed interconnect, multi-tier storage and cloud-like services (virtual machines, Kubernetes and Slurm)
requirements.text: Compute system must include specified components and services.

requirements.quote: Each accelerator shall have at least 192 GB of high-bandwidth memory, each node shall have local NVMe, and each GPU shall have a direct high-speed network connection
requirements.text: Accelerators, nodes, and GPUs must meet memory, storage, and network requirements.

requirements.quote: Compute racks shall accept 800 VDC input, and bidders shall state rack TDP. Racks with an AC input option shall list it separately
requirements.text: Compute racks must accept 800 VDC input, with TDP and AC input options specified.

requirements.quote: The maximum power of each deployment unit under any workload, including storage and network, shall not exceed 20 MW, and bidders shall state it in total and per partition
requirements.text: Deployment units must not exceed 20 MW power, with total and partitioned power stated.
